_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-72 base rate on ±2+ point moves makes HOLD the statistically honest default, and neither brain has identified a confirmed breaker — only conditions that would invalidate the coil.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both call HOLD on the phase, but disagree on WHY: analyst sees exhaustion with no dry powder (bearish coil), narrative sees coiled spring before re-expansion (bullish coil); the analyst's higher trust weight (7.67 vs 6.00) and factor-level evidence tips the consensus toward the analyst's more cautious framing.
next_move.confirmed_if: Score stays 39-46 for next 2-3 windows with VIX 13-15, funding flat, and BTC holding $61k-$64k — coil confirmed.
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks above 16 with funding spiking >0.01% (panic/down leg) OR ETF flows surge >50 with stablecoin growth flipping positive and DXY breaking below 98 (relief/hope leg) — either breaks the coil.
